blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Mobile robots operating among pedestrians need trajectories that become available quickly, remain spatially credible through missed observations, preserve identity, and fit within an embedded computing budget. Aggregate tracking scores provide limited insight into when and how trajectories fail, while varying detector inputs can confound tracker and detector quality. We present a deployment-focused, tracker-only evaluation protocol that uses shared detections to isolate tracker behavior and directly evaluates initialization, detector-gap continuation, identity recovery, close-neighbor association, and load-dependent tracker-step runtime, while Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA) is retained as a complementary aggregate measure. We apply the protocol to the JackRabbot Dataset and Benchmark (JRDB) using six open-source trackers and our lightweight Pedestrian Reference Tracker (PedRefTrack), together with a GT-assisted variant that estimates the remaining tracker-side gap under idealized association and motion. Under fixed detections, the non-GT trackers span only 24.26%–29.67% HOTA yet exhibit markedly different capability profiles. After 1.0 s without detector support, no tracker without GT assistance maintains spatially correct, same-identity output in more than half of eligible cases, making missing-observation continuation the dominant limitation among the tested properties. Close-neighbor failures are smaller and increase mainly at the shortest separations. Tracker-step runtime on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin is heavy-tailed and load-sensitive, causing several trackers to fall below the 10 Hz real-time target in crowded frames. The protocol provides a reproducible way to characterize tracker behavior and deployment suitability in pedestrian-centric environments. Code and evaluation scripts are released at https://github.com/SCAI-Lab/tracker_eval .
blocks.zh: 在行人中运行的移动机器人需要能迅速获得的轨迹,通过错失的观测保持空间可信度,保存身份,并符合嵌入式计算预算. 综合跟踪分数对轨迹故障的时间和方式提供了有限的洞察力,而不同的探测器输入会混淆跟踪器和探测器的质量. 我们提出了一个以部署为重点的、只跟踪器的评价协议,使用共享检测来隔离跟踪器的行为并直接评价初始化、检测器-gap延续、身份恢复、近邻关联和负载依赖跟踪器-步跑时间,同时保留更高秩序跟踪精确度(HOTA)作为补充汇总措施。 我们对JackRabbot数据集和基准(JRDB)应用协议,使用6个开源跟踪器和我们轻量级的Pedestria参考跟踪器(Ped RefTrack),以及GT辅助变体,在理想化的关联和运动下估计剩下的跟踪器-侧缺口. 在固定探测器下,非GT跟踪仪只跨越24.26%-29.67% HOTA仍然显示出明显不同的能力特征。 在1.0 s没有探测器支持后,没有GT援助的跟踪器在超过半数符合条件的案例中维持空间正确,同位素输出,使缺失观测继续成为被测试属性中的主要限制. 近邻故障较小,增加主要发生在最短的分离地. 一辆NVIDIA Jetson Orin上有轨电车步跑时间为重尾和负载敏感,导致多辆有轨电车在拥挤的相框下跌入10赫兹实时目标下. 协议提供了一种可再现的方法来描述以行人为中心的环境中的跟踪器行为和部署适合性. 代码和评价脚本在https://github.com/SCAI-Lab/tracker_eval上发布 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Robots operating in pedestrian-centric spaces such as hospitals, airports, and transit hubs need more than isolated pedestrian positions. A robot path planner uses recent trajectories to estimate walking direction and speed, predict near-term motion, assess collision risk, and choose socially compliant paths [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Tracking output must therefore arrive with limited delay, preserve identity, remain credible through missed observations, and be computed within the robot’s control cycle. Whether a tracker is suitable for deployment depends on its temporal behavior and failure conditions, not only on aggregate tracking accuracy.
blocks.zh: 在医院,机场,中转枢纽等以行人为中心的空间运营的机器人需要的不仅仅是孤立行人位置. 一个机器人路径规划师利用最近的轨迹来估计行走方向和速度,预测近期运动,评估相撞风险,并选择符合社会要求的路径[1,2,3]. 因此,跟踪输出必须以有限的延迟到达,保存身份,通过缺失的观察保持可信,并在机器人的控制周期内计算。 追踪器是否适合部署取决于其时间行为和故障条件,而不仅仅取决于聚合跟踪的准确性.

blocks.en: Most 3D multi-object tracking (MOT) systems are developed and evaluated on autonomous-driving datasets centered on roadway geometry and vehicle-mounted sensing [ 4 , 5 ] . Pedestrian-centric navigation presents a different operating regime in which people are observed at close range, nonlinear walking motion is common, and frequent partial occlusions arise from the crowd itself [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] . Performance established in the driving regime therefore does not by itself characterize the challenges faced by a mobile robot moving among pedestrians. Moreover, aggregate MOT scores summarize performance over an entire test set, providing limited insight into how tracker behavior relates to sequence complexity and deployment-relevant situations [ 9 , 10 ] . Attributing these differences to tracker design is further complicated when evaluation is performed with different input detections, since scores then reflect both detection and tracking behavior. Shared detections are established in 2D MOT benchmarking [ 11 , 12 ] , but their use is generally not enforced by 3D MOT and robot-centric pedestrian-tracking benchmarks [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 大多数3D多物体跟踪系统是在以公路几何学和车载感知[4,5]为中心的自动驾驶数据集上开发和评价的. 以行人为中心的通航呈现出一种不同的操作制度,人们在近距离观察,非线性行走运动是常见的,经常从人群本身产生部分隔离[6,7,8]. 因此,驾驶制度所确定的性能本身并不是移动机器人在行人之间移动所面临的挑战的特点。 此外,汇总的MOT分数总结了整个测试集的性能,对跟踪器行为如何与序列复杂性和部署相关情况的关系提供了有限的见解[9,10]. 当评价采用不同的输入检测时,将这些差异归因于跟踪器设计则更加复杂,因为分数随后既反映了检测行为,也反映了跟踪行为. 2D MOT基准[11,12]中设定了共享检测,但其使用一般不由3D MOT和以机器人为中心的行人跟踪基准[13,14,15,6]强制.

blocks.en: We therefore propose a deployment-focused, tracker-only protocol that evaluates tracker behavior under shared detections (Fig. 1 ) with embedded runtime across input loads. Eligible events are defined from GT and detection information so every tracker is evaluated under identical conditions.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提议一个以部署为重点的、只追踪器的协议,在共享检测(图1)下评价跟踪器的行为,并包含输入负载的嵌入式运行时间。 合格事件由GT和检测信息来定义,因此每个跟踪器在相同条件下进行评估.

blocks.en: Rather than introducing a new composite tracking score, the protocol complements HOTA with directly interpretable success profiles for initialization, continuation through detector gaps, post-gap identity recovery, and close-neighbor association, while separately profiling tracker-step runtime as a function of input load on embedded hardware. As part of the protocol, we implement PedRefTrack, a lightweight pedestrian-oriented reference tracker, together with a GT-assisted variant that uses GT identity and displacement to idealize association and motion estimation, exposing the remaining performance gap associated with these factors. We instantiate the protocol on JRDB [ 6 ] to provide an evaluation of how established tracking methods handle deployment-relevant challenges in a pedestrian-centric robot setting. A supplementary video provides an overview of the protocol and case-study results.
blocks.zh: 协议不是引入新的复合跟踪分数,而是以可直接解释的成功剖面来补充HOTA,用于初始化,通过探测器漏洞来延续,后gap身份恢复,以及近邻关联,同时将跟踪器-步跑时间作为嵌入式硬件上输入负载的函数单独剖面. 作为协议的一部分,我们实施了Ped RefTrack,这是一个轻量级行人导向的参考跟踪器,以及GT辅助变体,该变体使用GT身份和迁移来理想化关联和运动估计,暴露出与这些因素相关的剩余性能差距. 我们即时发布关于JRDB[6]的协议,以提供对既定跟踪方法如何处理以行人为中心的机器人环境中的部署相关挑战的评价. 补充录像概述了协议和案例研究结果。

blocks.en: Fig. 1 : Trajectory partition for deployment-focused tests. An example pedestrian trajectory is divided into three complementary regions. Green marks the first 0.5 0.5 s after detector support begins, blue marks mostly continuous supported motion containing only brief detection gaps, and orange marks longer gaps bounded by supported detections. Together, these regions span the trajectory and define separate event sets for the tests in Sec. III .
blocks.zh: 图1:用于部署重点测试的轨距分区. 例如行人行道分为三个互补区域. 绿色标记为探测器支持开始后的第一个0.5 s,蓝色标记多为连续被支持的运动,只包含短暂的探测缺口,橙色标记以被支持的探测为界限. 这些区域共同跨越了轨迹,并为第III节中的测试确定了单独的事件集。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Tracking requirements and evaluation
blocks.zh: 二.A 跟踪要求和评价

blocks.en: Prior work motivates evaluating tracking beyond aggregate accuracy from two complementary perspectives. MOT reviews identify frequent occlusions, track initialization and termination, identity maintenance, and interactions among multiple objects as persistent challenges [ 5 ] . From the deployment perspective, recent social-navigation evaluation guidelines emphasize scenario-aware benchmarks and metrics tied to the conditions and requirements of the target domain [ 10 ] . Together, these observations motivate evaluating not only overall tracking accuracy but also the temporal conditions under which trajectories remain usable.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作促使从两个互补角度评价超出总体准确性的追踪。 MOT审查发现,经常被隔离、跟踪初始化和终止、身份维护以及多个物体之间的互动是长期的挑战[5]。 从部署的角度来看,最近的社会导航评价准则强调与目标领域的条件和要求挂钩的情景意识基准和衡量标准[10]。 这些观察加在一起,不仅促使评价总体跟踪的准确性,而且促使评价轨迹仍然可用的时间条件。

blocks.en: These deployment-relevant temporal conditions are only indirectly reflected in standard aggregate MOT metrics. MOTA combines false negatives, false positives, and identity switches, but can be dominated by detection errors and represents association primarily through identity switches [ 16 , 17 ] . IDF1 instead emphasizes long-term identity consistency through a global one-to-one matching of predicted and GT trajectories, strongly penalizing fragmentation while ignoring association quality outside the selected trajectory pairings [ 17 , 18 ] . HOTA balances detection and association accuracy while integrating localization across thresholds [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 这些与部署有关的时间条件只是间接地反映在标准总的MOT指标中。 MOTA结合了假底片,假正片,和身份开关,但可以被检测错误所主导并主要通过身份开关代表关联[16,17]. 以色列国防军1则强调通过预测和GT轨迹的一对一的全球匹配来保持长期身份一致性,强烈地惩罚分化,而忽略了选定轨迹配对之外的联系质量[17、18]。 HOTA平衡了检测和关联精度,同时整合了跨阈值的本地化[17].

blocks.en: II-B 3D MOT families and representative open-source trackers
blocks.zh: II-B 3D MOT家庭和有代表性的开源跟踪器

blocks.en: MOT is commonly implemented in a tracking-by-detection paradigm, in which per-frame hypotheses are linked into trajectories through association and lifecycle management [ 5 ] . Joint detection–tracking formulations integrate association into the detection model, but tracking-by-detection remains the dominant interface among open-source 3D MOT systems [ 4 ] . Our study therefore focuses on online , detection-based methods that consume per-frame 3D boxes.
blocks.zh: MOT通常在逐一跟踪检测的范式中被实施,在范式中,通过关联和生命周期管理将每个帧的假说与轨迹联系起来[5]. 联合检测-跟踪配体将关联结合到检测模型中,但逐一跟踪仍然是开源3D MOT系统之间的主导接口[4]. 因此,我们的研究侧重于在线的、基于检测的方法,这些方法消耗每帧3D盒。

blocks.en: II-C Datasets across tracking domains
blocks.zh: 跨跟踪域的数据集

blocks.en: Autonomous-driving benchmarks such as KITTI [ 13 ] , nuScenes [ 14 ] , and Waymo [ 15 ] dominate 3D MOT evaluation but primarily represent vehicle-centric road traffic. Robot-centric pedestrian navigation instead places the ego platform in shared human spaces, where close encounters and dense interactions are more common. SiT explicitly reports substantially more close-proximity robot–pedestrian encounters than several autonomous-driving datasets [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 自动驾驶基准,如KITTI[13],nuScens[14],和Waymo[15]主导了3D MOT的评价,但主要代表以车辆为中心的道路交通. 以机器人为中心的行人导航则将自负平台放置在共享的人类空间中,在那里相近相遇和密集的相互作用更为常见. SiT明确报告远比几个自动驾驶数据集更接近的机器人 — pedestrian相遇 [8].

blocks.en: Robot-centric datasets themselves span diverse operating regimes. JRDB captures natural indoor and outdoor pedestrian activity on a university campus [ 6 ] , SiT covers urban scenes in Seoul, including streets, hallways, and crosswalks [ 8 ] , THÖR focuses on controlled indoor human–robot scenarios [ 29 ] , SCAND records socially compliant navigation demonstrations across varied indoor and outdoor environments [ 30 ] , and CrowdBot v2 emphasizes dense outdoor crowd navigation [ 31 ] . These datasets therefore expose complementary pedestrian interaction regimes.
blocks.zh: 以机器人为中心的数据集本身跨越不同的操作系统。 JRDB在大学校园内捕捉出自然的室内外行人活动[6],SiT覆盖了首尔的城市场景,包括街道,走廊,和横行道[8],THÖR专注于可控的室内人-机器人情景[29],SCAND记录了不同室内外环境的社会通航示威[30],CrowdBot v2强调密集的室外人群通航[31]. 因此,这些数据集暴露了互补的行人互动制度。

blocks.en: III Deployment-Focused Tracker-Only Protocol
blocks.zh: 三. 专用跟踪仪的部署

blocks.en: III-A Common inputs and matching
blocks.zh: 三-A 共同投入和匹配

blocks.en: Before evaluating trackers, we define detector support from the shared detections. In each frame, GT boxes and detections are matched one-to-one using Hungarian assignment on XY-center distance, with a 0.30 0.30 m gate. Tracker outputs are evaluated separately: in each frame, they are assigned one-to-one to GT by maximizing oriented 3D IoU, with matches requiring IoU ≥ 0.30 \geq 0.30 . This requires meaningful overlap while tolerating some pedestrian-box errors. For tracker i i , GT trajectory g g , and time t t , let J i ​ ( g , t ) J_{i}(g,t) denote the identity of the accepted tracker output, and set J i ​ ( g , t ) = NA J_{i}(g,t)=\mathrm{NA} if no output meets the overlap criterion.
blocks.zh: 在评价追踪器之前,我们定义了来自共享探测器的探测器支持. 在每个相框中,GT盒和探测器采用匈牙利指派的XY-中距相匹配一比一,并有0.30 0.30米的门. 对跟踪器输出进行单独评价:在每一帧中,通过最大化取向的3D IoU将其一对一分配给GT,匹配需要IoU 0.30\克 0.30 (英语). 这需要有意义的重叠,同时容忍一些行人框错误. 对于 tracker i, GT 轨迹 g, 和时间 t t, 让 J i (g, t) J {i} (g, t) 表示被接受的 tracker 输出的身份, 如果输出不符合重叠标准, 设置 J i (g, t) = NA J {i} (g, t) { mathrm{ NA}.

blocks.en: Event eligibility, detector-gap duration, and nearest-neighbor difficulty are derived only from GT and the shared detections. Tracker output determines event success, but event eligibility is fixed independently of the tracker. All methods are therefore evaluated on the same events.
blocks.zh: 事件资格,探测器-gap持续时间,以及近邻难度仅取自GT和共享检测. 跟踪器输出决定了事件的成功,但事件的资格是独立于跟踪器之外的固定的. 因此,所有方法都在同一事件中进行评估。

blocks.en: III-B HOTA and PedRefTrack
blocks.zh: 三-B HOTA 和 Ped RefTrack

blocks.en: At a localization threshold α \alpha , HOTA is the geometric mean of detection and association accuracy [ 17 ] : HOTA α = DetA α ​ AssA α . \mathrm{HOTA}_{\alpha}=\sqrt{\mathrm{DetA}_{\alpha}\,\mathrm{AssA}_{\alpha}}. (1) The reported HOTA averages this score over localization thresholds. DetA separates further into detection recall and precision (DetRe and DetPr), AssA into association recall and precision (AssRe and AssPr), and LocA reports spatial alignment. The decomposition provides a split-wide summary of broad detection, association, and localization errors.
blocks.zh: 在本地化阈值α-α,HOTA是检测和关联精度的几何平均值 [17]:HOTA α = DetA α AssA α.\mathrm{HOTA}_{\alpha}=\sqt{\mathrm{ DetA}_{\alpha}\,\mathrm{Asalpha}}. (1) 所报告的HOTA平均值是该分数超过本地化阈值。 DetA进一步分离为检测召回和精度(DetRe和DetPr),AssA为关联召回和精度(Assre和AssPr),而LocA报告空间对接. 分解提供了一分解的大致检测,关联,以及本地化出错的概括.

blocks.en: To estimate how much performance can be recovered through tracker design, we implement PedRefTrack , a lightweight pedestrian-oriented tracking-by-detection reference assembled from established practices. It targets real-time LiDAR inference on embedded hardware such as Jetson Orin even in crowded frames. PedRefTrack combines a low-cost constant-velocity Kalman filter, moving and stationary retention modes, score-aware confirmation, two-pass IoU and distance association, filtered box geometry, and separate lifetimes for published predictions and hidden identity retention. A key distinction is that PedRefTrack does not choose coasting duration from one fixed timeout or the latest detector score. At the onset of a detector gap, it measures recent pre-correction Kalman residuals to estimate how accurately its motion model predicted that trajectory before support disappeared. A shifted exponential maps this prediction error to a configurable interval between T min T_{\min} and T max T_{\max} , set to 0.5 0.5 and 2.0 2.0 s in our experiments. Accurate recent prediction therefore yields a longer published coasting horizon. A second limit predicts, under relative constant velocity, when two pedestrian centers first come within 0.5 0.5 m and caps the published horizon before that encounter. Moving and stationary tracks can remain hidden for 2.5 2.5 and 5.0 5.0 s, respectively, so identity recovery does not require publishing an uncertain position throughout the gap.
blocks.zh: 为了估计通过跟踪器设计可以回收多少性能,我们实施了Ped RefTrack(Ped RefTrack),这是一个轻量级的以行人为导向的逐一跟踪,从既定做法中收集的参考文献. 它针对嵌入式硬件如杰特森·奥林(Jetson Orin)的实时LiDAR推论,甚至在拥挤的帧. Ped RefTrack结合了低成本的常速卡尔曼滤波器,移动和固定保留模式,分数识别确认,双通IoU和距离关联,过滤箱几何,以及用于发布预测和隐藏身份保留的独立寿命. 一个关键区别是Ped RefTrack没有从一个固定的超时或最新的探测器分数中选择海岸持续时间. 在探测器间隙开始时,它测量了最近的前修正卡尔曼残留物,以估计其运动模型在支持消失前预测出轨迹的准确性. 将这个预测错误转换成 T min T_{\min} 和 T Max T_{\max} 之间的可配置间隔, 因此,最近准确的预测得出了较长的沿海地平线。 第二个限制在相对恒定速度下预测,两个行人中心首次到达0.5米以内,并在遇上之前将公布的地平线盖上. 移动和固定轨道可以分别隐藏2.52.5和5.0 5.0 s,因此身份恢复不需要在整个缺口中公布不确定位置.

blocks.en: In GT-assisted PedRefTrack, GT identity and displacement disambiguate association and motion for true pedestrian tracks. The tracker still uses the shared detections for box geometry and retains the same confirmation, filtering, coasting, and finite-lifetime decisions. Unmatched detections can still create false-positive tracks. This is not perfect tracking, but a diagnostic estimate of the performance that could be recovered if association and pedestrian motion were known more reliably.
blocks.zh: 在GT援助的Ped RefTrack中,GT的身份和流离失所使真正行人行道的关联和运动脱节. 追踪器仍然使用共享检测来进行箱形几何,并保留了相同的确认,过滤,海岸化,以及有限寿命的决定. 无法匹配的检测仍能产生出假阳性轨道. 这不是完美的跟踪,而是对性能的诊断性估计,如果能更可靠地了解关联和行人运动,这种估计是可以恢复的.

blocks.en: III-C Trajectory-level success tests
blocks.zh: 三-C 轨迹级成功测试

blocks.en: The four tests below define the eligible trajectory events and the success criterion used for each deployment behavior.
blocks.zh: 以下四项测试定义了合格的轨迹事件和每种部署行为所使用的成功标准.

blocks.en: IV Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 四. 实验设置

blocks.en: IV-A Data, detections, and evaluation
blocks.zh: 数据、检测和评价

blocks.en: We evaluate the 27-sequence JRDB test split in a common world frame using STEAM-LO odometry [ 32 ] . Every tracker receives the same post-NMS Person-MinkUNet pedestrian detections, trained on the JRDB training split, with score s ≥ 0.5 s\geq 0.5 [ 33 ] . No tracker uses a GPU.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 STEAM-LO odometry [32] 来评估 27 序列 JRDB 测试在共同的世界框架中分裂. 每个追踪器都得到同样的NMS后Person-MinkUNet行人探测器,接受过JRDB训练分出训练,得分为 0.5 s\geq 0.5 [33]. 没有跟踪器使用GPU.

blocks.en: Evaluation correction. We found that the official JRDB 3D-IoU routine used enclosing rather than intersection height for vertical overlap, inflating 3D IoU and HOTA. We corrected this and the routine’s oriented-footprint clipping. All reported results use the corrected evaluator and are therefore not directly comparable to the official JRDB leaderboard.
blocks.zh: 评价更正。 我们发现,JRDB 3D-IoU的官方常规是用相接高度而不是相接高度来进行垂直重叠,夸大了3D IoU和HOTA. 我们纠正了这种情况,并纠正了例行的以脚印为导向的剪辑。 所有报告的结果都使用经更正的评价员,因此不能与JRDB的正式领导板直接相媲美。

blocks.en: IV-B Compared trackers and runtime platform
blocks.zh: 四-B 比较跟踪器和运行时间平台

blocks.en: We compare AB3DMOT [ 19 ] , Fast-Poly [ 24 ] , SimpleTrack [ 21 ] , CBMOT [ 22 ] , GNN-PMB [ 25 ] , box-only ELPTNet [ 34 ] , PedRefTrack, and its GT-assisted variant. The available ELPTNet implementation did not fully reproduce the paper’s architecture, so we enabled its documented output gate and bounded prediction through missed detections. Exposed parameters were tuned to maximize HOTA, with configurable output coasting set to the longest duration before HOTA decreased. Success-rate bands are 95% bootstrap intervals from sequence resampling. Figure 3 (b) reports sample counts for the gap, nearest-neighbor, and runtime strata.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了AB3DMOT [19],快通 [24],简单追踪 [21],CBMOT [22],GNN-PMB [25],只收箱的ELPTNet [34],Ped RefTrack,及其GT辅助变体. 可用的ELPTNet执行没有完全复制纸张的架构,因此,我们启用了文件记录的出品门,并通过漏取的检测进行了有限度的预测。 曝光参数被调取以尽量扩大HOTA,可配置产出海岸化设定为HOTA减少前最长的长度. 成功率的带从序列再生中是95%的靴子间隔. 图3(b) 报告样本对差距、最近的邻居和运行时间层进行了统计。

blocks.en: Runtime is measured on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin 64 GB in maximum-power mode. We use 10 Hz as a conservative real-time target for common spinning-LiDAR frame rates.
blocks.zh: 运行时间在最大功率模式下用NVIDIA Jetson Orin 64 GB测量. 我们用10赫兹作为保守的实时目标,用于常见的旋转-LiDAR帧率.

blocks.en: IV-C GT-derived detector perturbations
blocks.zh: 四-C GT衍生探测器扰动

blocks.en: To examine how tracker HOTA performance changes as observation quality steadily degrades, we create pseudo detections from GT and apply controlled dropout and box-instability perturbations. Figure 2 illustrates these failure modes. Dropout introduces increasingly long intervals without detector support, while instability perturbs box geometry through persistent trajectory-level biases and smaller frame-wise jitter. For instability, each trajectory draws K K persistent box-error hypotheses and probabilistically switches among them. The final comparison combines matched dropout and instability severities from Table I , providing every tracker with the same controlled increase in input difficulty.
blocks.zh: 为了检查跟踪器HOTA的性能如何随着观测质量的稳步下降而变化,我们从GT中创建了伪检测器,并应用了可控的退出和盒式扰动. 图2说明了这些失败模式。 辍学使间隔越来越长,没有探测器支持,而不稳定则通过持续的轨迹水平偏差和较小的帧颤动来扰动框几何。 对于不稳定性,每个轨迹都绘制出K K 持续的箱-误差假说,并在其中进行概率交换. 最后的比较结合了表一的辍学和不稳定的断层,使每个跟踪器在输入困难方面都得到同样的控制增加。

blocks.en: Fig. 2 : GT-derived detector-input models. Dropout removes contiguous observations. Instability introduces perturbations to box center, orientation, and dimensions. Combined inputs apply matched dropout and instability severities.
blocks.zh: 图2:GT衍生探测器-输入模型. 退学可以消除毗连观测. 不稳定性将扰动引入了盒子中心、取向和维度。 综合投入适用了相应的辍学和不稳定断裂。

L/W/H values are relative.

blocks.zh: 图3:以行人为中心的设置和评价覆盖面。 (a) JRDB场景。 (b) 支持探测器-差距、近邻和运行时间分析的计数。

blocks.en: V Results
blocks.zh: 五 结果

blocks.en: V-A Aggregate accuracy and deployment variation
blocks.zh: V-A 合计精确度和部署变化

blocks.en: Table II reports HOTA and its decomposition. GT-assisted PedRefTrack reaches 33.33% HOTA, compared with 29.67% for PedRefTrack and 27.48% for Fast-Poly, corresponding to deficits of 3.66 and 5.85 percentage points. Methods without GT assistance span only 24.26–29.67% HOTA, providing limited separation for tracker selection. LocA is narrower still at 65.49–66.15%, indicating that the HOTA differences arise mainly from track-output and association behavior rather than localization.
blocks.zh: 表二报告了HOTA及其分解情况。 GT援助的Ped RefTrack达到33.33%的HOTA,而Ped RefTrack为29.67%,快通为27.48%,相当于3.66和5.85个百分点的赤字. 没有GT援助的方法只有24.26-29.67%的HOTA,为跟踪者选择提供了有限的分离. LocA仍然缩小到65.49–66.15%,表明HOTA的差异主要出自于跟踪输出和关联行为而不是本地化.

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows why a single split-wide number remains incomplete. The 10th–90th percentile ranges in panel (a) reveal large variation in both sequence HOTA and frame runtime. Panel (b) instead pairs every sequence with GT-assisted PedRefTrack before taking the difference. This removes the easy-versus-difficult sequence variation and shows the tracker-side deficit on the same scene. The varying ranges show that tracker choice affects both average accuracy and its consistency across scenes.
blocks.zh: 图4显示为什么单一的分块数字仍然不完整。 第10-90个百分位数在(a)面板中显示出HOTA和帧运行时间的相差很大。 小组(b) 将每组序列与GT辅助的Ped RefTrack对齐,然后取出差异。 这可以去除容易和困难的序列变异,并显示同一场景的追踪器-侧缺. 不同的范围表明,跟踪器的选择既会影响平均准确性,也会影响场景的一致性。

blocks.en: Fig. 4 : Accuracy, runtime, and tracker-side headroom. (a) HOTA versus median tracker-step FPS. Whiskers show the 10th–90th percentile ranges of sequence HOTA (vertical) and frame-level FPS (horizontal). (b) Per-sequence HOTA deficit to GT-assisted PedRefTrack, with quantiles from paired same-sequence differences. GT-assisted PedRefTrack idealizes association and motion while retaining the remaining tracker pipeline.
blocks.zh: 图4:准确度、运行时间和跟踪器侧室。 (a) HOTA与中位跟踪器步骤FPS。 Whiskers显示序列HOTA(垂直)和帧级FPS(横向)的第10-90百分位范围. (b) 偶序HOTA赤字为GT辅助Ped RefTrack,从对等的同序差异分出等分数。 GT辅助的Ped RefTrack将关联和运动理想化,同时保留了剩余的跟踪管.

blocks.en: The shared-input tests in Fig. 5 reveal differences hidden by aggregate results. In panel (a), GT-assisted PedRefTrack retains the original, spatially accepted identity through 1.0 1.0 s in 86.8 % 86.8\% of eligible gaps. SimpleTrack reaches 45.4 % 45.4\% and PedRefTrack 37.0 % 37.0\% , while the remaining methods are below 1 % 1\% . Thus, a tracker may continue publishing yet retain spatially correct, same-ID output in fewer than half the gaps. The decline is consistent with open-loop extrapolation becoming unreliable over longer gaps, while lifecycle policy also limits published prediction duration. Gap success therefore reflects both motion prediction and output-lifetime policy. Identity recovery is markedly stronger than published continuation. At 0.5 0.5 s, Fast-Poly, GNN-PMB, and CBMOT maintain valid output through about 0.2 % 0.2\% of gaps, yet recover pre-gap identity in 78.9 % 78.9\% , 59.8 % 59.8\% , and 75.1 % 75.1\% . At 1.5 1.5 s, PedRefTrack, Fast-Poly, SimpleTrack, and CBMOT recover 69.8 % 69.8\% , 55.8 % 55.8\% , 50.0 % 50.0\% , and 41.9 % 41.9\% , while AB3DMOT, GNN-PMB, and ELPTNet remain below 5 % 5\% . The recovery contrast reflects lifecycle differences, as some methods discard identity state when coasting ends while others retain dormant state for re-association.
blocks.zh: 图5中的共享输入测试揭示了汇总结果所隐藏的差异. 在面板(a)中,GT所协助的Ped RefTrack通过1.0 s保留了原始的,空间上接受的身份,在86.8%的合格缺口中保留了86.8\%. 简单跟踪达到45.4% 45.4% 和 Ped RefTrack 37.0% 37.0 % , 其余方法低于1% 1% 。 因此,一个跟踪器可能继续发布,但在不到一半的缺口中保留空间正确、相同的ID输出。 这一下降与开放-loop外推法在较长的缺口中变得不可靠是一致的,而生命周期政策也限制了公布的预测期限. 因此,差距的成功反映了运动预测和产出寿命政策。 身份的恢复明显比公布的延续更为有力。 在0.5 s,快邮,GNN-PMB,和CBMOT通过0.2%的缺口保持有效输出,但在78.9%的78.9%,59.8%的59.8 %,75.1%的75.1 % 恢复差距前身份. 在1.5 s,Ped RefTrack,快邮,简易跟踪,和CBMOT恢复69.8%的69.8 %,55.8%的55.8 %,50.0%的50.0 % 和41.9%的41.9 % ,而AB3DMOT,GNN-PMB,以及ELPTNet仍然低于5%的5 % 。 恢复对比反映了生命周期的差异,因为有些方法在海岸结束时放弃身份状态,而另一些方法则保留休眠状态进行再结合。

blocks.en: Figure 5 (c) shows continuity worsening with pedestrian-pedestrian distance. As nearest-neighbor distance decreases from 0.7 0.7 – 0.8 0.8 m to 0.3 0.3 – 0.4 0.4 m, failure rises across trackers without GT assistance, by 2.3 2.3 percentage points for PedRefTrack and up to 13.5 13.5 for GNN-PMB. The deficit to GT-assisted PedRefTrack also widens, from 2.0 2.0 – 15.7 15.7 at 0.6 0.6 – 0.7 0.7 m to 4.1 4.1 – 25.2 25.2 in the closest bin. Close-neighbor association failures remain smaller than during 1.0 1.0 s detector gaps, making gap handling and motion extrapolation the larger limitation in this JRDB case study, while proximity becomes most consequential below about 0.5 0.5 m.
blocks.zh: 图5(c)显示,行人与行人之间的距离持续恶化。 随着相邻距离从0.7 — 0.8 0.8米降至0.3 0.3 — 0.4米,没有GT援助的跟踪器故障率上升,Ped RefTrack的故障率上升了2.3分,而GNN-PMB的故障率高达13.5 13.5分. 赤字到GT辅助的Ped RefTrack也有所扩大,从2.0 2.0 — 15.7 15.7 以0.6 0.6 — 0.7 0.7 m为4.1 4.1 — 25.2 25.2 位于最靠近的邮箱. 近邻结合故障仍然小于1.0 s探测器间隙期间,使间隙处理和运动外推成为JRDB案例研究中较大的局限性,而相近性则在0.5 m左右下产生最大的影响.

blocks.en: Initialization also varies substantially across trackers. By 0.5 0.5 s, 39.1 39.1 – 56.0 % 56.0\% of shared trajectory starts are stably established, with larger differences at shorter delays. At 0.2 0.2 s, Fast-Poly has established 45.0 % 45.0\% of starts versus 29.4 % 29.4\% for PedRefTrack, showing substantially earlier establishment. By 0.4 0.4 s, PedRefTrack reaches 46.5 % 46.5\% versus 46.8 % 46.8\% , with higher detection precision ( 41.3 % 41.3\% versus 39.8 % 39.8\% ) and much longer valid coasting in panel (a). These results expose an initialization trade-off: earlier output reduces establishment delay, whereas more selective confirmation can improve detection precision at the cost of later availability.
blocks.zh: 不同跟踪器的初始化也有很大差异。 以0.5 s, 39.1 39.1– 56.0 % 56.0%的共享轨迹开始被稳定地确定,在更短的延迟时间出现较大差异. 在0.2秒时,快邮公司建立了45.0%的起步点,而Ped RefTrack公司则建立了29.4%的起步点,这在很大程度上表明它更早。 Ped RefTrack的检测精度较高(41.3%与39.8%), 这些结果暴露出初始化取舍:更早的产出会减少建立延迟,而更有选择性的确认可以提高检测精度,而后期的提供则会付出代价.

blocks.en: V-C Runtime depends on detection load
blocks.zh: V-C 运行时间取决于检测负荷

blocks.en: Tracker-step throughput decreases strongly with detection count (Fig. 6 ), with several methods falling below the 10 Hz target as load increases. CBMOT, ELPTNet, and PedRefTrack remain above 10 Hz at the highest displayed loads, with PedRefTrack retaining about 15.2 FPS in the 75–80 detection bin. Fast-Poly falls below 10 Hz at roughly 45 detections, while AB3DMOT, GNN-PMB, and SimpleTrack do so at substantially lower loads.
blocks.zh: 跟踪步骤的吞吐量会随着检测计数(图6)而大幅下降,随着负载的增加,几种方法会低于10赫兹的目标. CBMOT,ELPTNet,和Ped RefTrack在所显示的最大载荷上保持在10赫兹以上,而Ped RefTrack在75-80检测箱中保留了约15.2 FPS. Fast-Poly在大约45次探测时低于10赫兹;而AB3DMOT、GNN-PMB和SimpleTrack则在负载大大降低的情况下这样做。

blocks.en: Fig. 6 : Tracker-step FPS versus input detections. Whiskers show the 10th–90th quantiles, and the dashed line marks the 10 Hz LiDAR rate. Detector inference is excluded.
blocks.zh: 图6:跟踪步FPS对输入检测. Whiskers显示第10个-90个等分数,而破折线标出10个Hz LiDAR率. 探测器推论不在此列.

blocks.en: Fig. 7 : GT-derived detector perturbations. The upper strip shows GT-assisted PedRefTrack HOTA. The main panel shows each tracker’s HOTA deficit to this reference. Mild, moderate, and severe correspond to Table I .
blocks.zh: 图7:GT衍生探测器扰动. 上行条显示由GT辅助的Ped RefTrack HOTA. 主面板显示每个追踪者的HOTA赤字与这个参考. 中度和严重与表一相对应。

blocks.en: V-D Controlled GT-derived perturbations
blocks.zh: V-D 受控GT衍生扰动

blocks.en: The main panel in Fig. 7 shows each tracker’s HOTA deficit to GT-assisted PedRefTrack as dropout and box instability increase from mild to severe. The deficits are compressed under mild corruption but separate substantially with increasing severity. PedRefTrack and Fast-Poly show the smallest deficit growth, indicating greater robustness to the modeled observation loss and instability, while the remaining trackers lose progressively more ground to the GT-assisted reference. Tracker choice therefore becomes more consequential as observation support degrades. Similar aggregate robustness does not imply similar trajectory behavior: PedRefTrack and Fast-Poly remain close across severities, yet Fig. 5 shows markedly different initialization, gap-continuation, and identity-recovery profiles.
blocks.zh: Fig. 7的主要面板显示,随着辍学和箱型不稳定性从温和到严重地增加,每个田径运动员的HOTA赤字到GT援助的Ped RefTrack。 赤字在温和的腐败下被压缩,但随着日益严重而大相径庭。 Ped RefTrack and Fast-Poly显示赤字增长最小,表明模型观测损失和不稳定性更强,而其余的跟踪者则逐渐失去更多GT援助的参考依据. 因此,随着观测支持的退化,跟踪器的选择就变得更加重要。 类似的整体稳健性并不意味着类似的轨迹行为:Ped RefTrack和快波利在断裂处保持相近,然而图5显示了显著不同的初始化、差距持续和身份恢复概况。

blocks.en: VI Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: While scalar benchmark values like HOTA provide a useful, compact aggregate summary, they do not directly reveal which deployment-relevant tracker behaviors are reliable or where failures occur. Our protocol complements this view with intuitive success rates for defined tracking situations and runtime measured across input loads, while shared detections keep the comparison focused on tracker behavior. Applied to JRDB, the protocol shows that methods with similar HOTA reach that aggregate performance through different trade-offs. Some establish trajectories earlier, others maintain valid output longer through missed observations or retain identity for later recovery, and their runtime scales differently with pedestrian load, which is critical for robots with limited onboard compute. By exposing these properties separately, the protocol provides an interpretable profile of tracker behavior and identifies which capabilities remain limiting in a given pedestrian-centric environment.
blocks.zh: 虽然像HOTA这样的scalar基准值提供了一个有用的,紧凑的汇总,但是它们并没有直接显示哪些部署相关的跟踪器行为是可靠的或者发生故障的地方. 我们的协议以直观的成功率来补充这个观点,这些成功率用于定义的跟踪状况和在输入负载中测量的运行时间,而共享的检测则保持了对跟踪者的行为的对比. 应用于JRDB,协议显示,类似HOTA的方法通过不同的取舍来达到这种总性能. 有的更早建立出轨,有的通过错失了观测或保留了身份以进行后期恢复而维持了更长时间的有效输出,有的运行时间尺度与行人负载不同,这对机上计算有限的机器人至关重要. 通过单独披露这些属性,协议提供了可解释的追踪器行为概况,并确定了在特定以行人为中心的环境中哪些能力仍然受到限制.

blocks.en: The capability profiles suggest tracker-design priorities. In JRDB, detector-gap continuation degrades more severely than close-neighbor association, pointing to motion prediction during detection gaps as the largest limitation among tested properties. Gap success depends on both motion extrapolation and lifecycle policy, but its sharp decline with gap duration is consistent with open-loop prediction becoming unreliable when pedestrian motion changes. This motivates richer pedestrian-motion models incorporating local interactions and scene context. The proximity and recovery results motivate pedestrian-specific structural and temporal features beyond box geometry, which could disambiguate nearby pedestrians and support post-gap re-association when return positions deviate from motion predictions. Several trackers recover identity far more often than they maintain valid gap output. Together with initialization results, this motivates separating confirmation, published coasting, and hidden identity retention so that uncertain positions can be suppressed without discarding state useful for later re-association.
blocks.zh: 能力简介提出了跟踪器设计的优先次序。 在JRDB中,探测器-gap续作的降解比近邻相接更严重,指出在检测间隙时的运动预测是被测试属性中最大的限制. 间隙成功与否既取决于运动外推法,也取决于生命周期政策,但其随着间隙持续时间的缩短而急剧下降,这与行人间运动改变时开放-间隙预测变得不可靠是一致的. 这激励了更丰富的行人-动车模式,将当地互动和场景背景纳入其中. 相近和复原结果刺激了箱形几何以外的行人特有的结构和时间特征,这可能会使附近的行人脱节,并在返回位置偏离运动预测时支持后行人重新参与。 几个追踪器恢复身份的频率远高于它们保持有效差距输出的频率. 与初始化结果一起,这激励分离确认,被公布的海岸化,以及隐藏的身份保留,从而可以抑制不确定的位置而不会丢弃状态,对后期的再结合有用.

blocks.en: The study is limited to one JRDB-trained detector operating point and one pedestrian-centric dataset. GT-derived perturbations broaden the input conditions but do not reproduce the full error structure of a learned detector, and the reported profiles reflect HOTA-tuned configurations under selected matching thresholds and temporal horizons rather than each tracker’s full operating range. Runtime covers only tracker-step execution on one embedded platform and excludes the remaining perception and navigation stack. Finally, the tests are deployment-oriented proxies rather than direct navigation measures. These limitations motivate validation across further datasets, detector regimes, tracker settings, hardware platforms, and downstream navigation tasks.
blocks.zh: 该研究仅限于一个JRDB训练有素的探测器操作点和一个以行人为中心的数据集. GT派生的扰动拓宽了输入条件,但不复制所学探测器的全部出错结构,所报道的剖面图反映了HOTA在选定的匹配阈值和时平线下所调整的配置,而不是每个跟踪器的全部运行范围. 运行时只覆盖一个嵌入式平台上的跟踪器步执行,并排除了剩余的感知和导航堆栈. 最后,试验是面向部署的代用措施,而不是直接导航措施。 这些限制促使进一步验证数据集、探测器系统、跟踪器设置、硬件平台和下游导航任务。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: We presented a deployment-focused, tracker-only protocol that complements HOTA with directly interpretable success profiles and load-aware embedded runtime evaluation under shared detections. Applied to JRDB, the protocol shows that trackers with similar HOTA can differ substantially in initialization, detector-gap continuation, identity recovery, close-neighbor behavior, and runtime scaling. PedRefTrack remains competitive across aggregate accuracy and capability profiles while exceeding 10 Hz at the highest tested loads on a single Jetson Orin CPU core. Among the tested properties, detector-gap continuation is the largest limitation, while post-gap identity recovery remains much stronger and close-neighbor failures increase mainly at short separations. These results support complementing aggregate measures such as HOTA with deployment-relevant capability profiles to better assess tracker suitability in a given environment.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个以部署为重点的、只追踪器的协议,以可直接解释的成功简介和共同检测下负载感内置的运行时间评价作为HOTA的补充。 被应用于JRDB,协议显示,具有类似HOTA的跟踪器在初始化,探测器-gap续作,身份恢复,近邻行为,和运行时间缩放等方面可以有很大差异. Ped RefTrack在总精度和能力剖面上仍然具有竞争力,同时在一个Jetson Orin CPU核心上测试出的最高载荷超过10赫兹. 在被测试的属性中,探测器-gap续作是最大的限制,而后gap身份恢复仍然更强大,近邻故障增加主要发生在短距离分离. 这些成果有助于补充诸如HOTA等综合措施,提供与部署有关的能力简介,以更好地评估追踪器在特定环境中的适宜性。
